name: Noise Meter
description: Measure how loud it is around you with a gauge, min, average, max and a live chart.
prompt: A sound level meter using the microphone that shows approximate decibels on a gauge with a needle, a label like library or traffic, min, average and max, and a live chart.
author: gonzaroman
